tests.assertion: test('4951/2151已损HP附粉60至120独立递增封顶，属性与药剂不递增，粉免仍执行记录',()=>withoutCapacity(()=>{const s=make({move:10001,soul:true,hp:8000,loadout:[10001,20017,29468,29469,38572]});for(const rate of[60,80,100,120,120]){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;turn(s,10001,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),1000*rate/100);}const before=s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2151.damageRate;turn(s,20017,20309);turn(s,null,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2151.damageRate,before);const x=make({move:10001,soul:true,hp:8000});timer(x,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(x,10001,20309);assert.equal(sum(x,'percent'),0);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.wind2151.damageRate,80);}));

tests.assertion: test('4951全部17招基础真实HP分类PP及原始优先级，真实14404三目标字段保留且当前单目标仅一包',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,index:-1,aStats:{atk:180,spa:18}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,m.priority);const es=(s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack');assert.equal(es.length,m.kind==='status'?0:1,m.name);if(es.length){assert.equal(es[0].attackValue,m.kind==='physical'?180:18);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000-es[0].hpLoss);assert.equal(es[0].settledDamage>0,m.power>0);}const z=make({move:m.id,index:-1});z.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(z,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);}const m=source.moves.find(m=>m.id===14404),c=E.WIKI.compile(m,source);assert.equal(m.sourceTargetCount,3);assert.equal(c.ignoredSourceFeatures[0].value,3);});
